source.dataset: Real dependabot[bot] PR, verified directly (no case-level academic benchmark exists for GitHub Actions)
source.note: Prompt is the verbatim, real PR title (only "(.github/workflows/ci.yml)" appended to anchor the file). actions/checkout appears in ~36% of all workflow steps per Decan & Mens, JSS 2023 (https://decan.lexpage.net/files/JSS-2023.pdf). The seed pins the exact old version the real PR bumped from; the prompt's target (v4) is itself now stale, directly probing whether yul pushes past a real but outdated bump target to the actual current latest.

seed:
name: CI
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5.3.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: pytest

source.note: Prompt is the verbatim, real PR title. actions/setup-python is among the most-used language setup actions per Decan & Mens, JSS 2023.

name: CI

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-m2-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
      - run: mvn -B verify
